description: Normalizes the line endings of the files a batch of tool calls wrote, once per batch, so a checkout's own EOL policy holds in the working tree.

hooks.command: sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.sh" node-notice /eol-normalizer:check EOL_NORMALIZER_ENABLED; ${PPID:+exit}; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.ps1" node-notice /eol-normalizer:check EOL_NORMALIZER_ENABLED
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that node is on PATH...
